prompt.project_info: Create an upper-body high-key fashion beauty portrait with a bold red accessory palette and playful kiss-mark makeup motif.
prompt.main_subject: An adult fictional woman with original non-celebrity features, realistic skin texture, dramatic editorial makeup, glossy deep-crimson lipstick, and multiple artistic red lipstick kiss marks across the cheeks and upper shoulders. She wears a classic red wool beret, oversized red heart-shaped sunglasses with generic frames, and elbow-length red satin gloves.
prompt.composition_elements: Confident playful pose, head tilted slightly, gloved hand lifting the sunglasses above the eyes, intense gaze past camera, minimalist seamless white studio backdrop, upper-body medium close-up.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Professional softbox lighting with gentle feathered shadows, even high-key exposure, natural catchlights, accurate red tones, sophisticated fashion-magazine mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Full-frame 85mm prime-lens look, f/4 depth of field, ISO 100 visual quality, ultra-high-resolution realistic skin pores and fabric texture, clean reflections in sunglasses.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: High-key upper-body fashion beauty editorial of an adult fictional woman with original non-celebrity features, realistic skin texture, glossy deep-crimson lipstick and artistic red lipstick kiss marks across cheeks and upper shoulders. She wears a red wool beret, oversized generic red heart-shaped sunglasses, and elbow-length red satin gloves, lifting the sunglasses with one gloved hand while gazing confidently past camera. Minimalist seamless white studio, professional softbox lighting, gentle feathered shadows, accurate red tones, 85mm f/4 full-frame portrait quality.
prompt.negative_prompt: celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, exact facial identity, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, blurry, low quality, distorted anatomy, malformed hands, excessive smearing, recognizable logo, watermark, text, signature, plastic skin, cartoonish proportions
